notes.title: Sky Ahoy Next Fest Dev Stream
notes.content: [p][b]Join us live for the Sky Ahoy Next Fest Stream![/b][/p][p]Cogs and Gears Games will be chatting with the Mytholite team and answering your questions live as we dive into the Sky Ahoy demo! We’ll be sharing behind-the-scenes insights, development stories, and exciting details about what’s coming up for the Early Access release. Come hang out, ask us anything, and get a closer look at the world of Sky Ahoy![/p]
